<b>Wraiths</b> are [[Enemies (Silksong)|enemies]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>. They are ghost-like beings made of silk and the smog of the [[Exhaust Organ]] and the only hostile inhabitants of [[the Mist]].<ref>Wraith Hunter's Journal entry: <i>"Not a bug but a projection of another's will cast in smog and Silk."</i></ref>

== In-game Events ==

Wraiths normally spawn in [[the Mist]]; however, that area becomes inaccessible once [[Phantom]] is defeated, making it no longer possible to fight them.

Defeating [[Phantom]] also completes the Wraiths' entry in the [[Hunter's Journal (Silksong)|Hunter's Journal]] if it has not been completed already.

== Behaviour and Tactics ==
Wraiths remain passive until approached by Hornet. When Hornet nears a Wraith, it screams and begins to follow her; then, when Hornet is within range of their attack, the Wraith screams and charges at her horizontally. Wraiths ignore all obstacles and can pursue Hornet through walls and platforms. If Hornet is caught, it deals {{Damage|1+1}} and drains 3 strands of Silk.

Wraiths only charge horizontally, so carefully timed jumps can allow Hornet to avoid a Wraith's attack and retaliate with downward strikes while she is airborne. 
{{CrestSlot|Red|s}} such as [[Sting Shard]] and [[Threefold Pin]] are also useful.

Wraiths will respawn in one of their pre-determined locations after 3 seconds after being killed. As such it is best to not stay in one place for too long after one is killed.

{{SS Needolin|columns=2|

== Location ==
Wraiths can be found in [[the Mist]]. Each room in the Mist contains points where Wraiths can spawn, but which spot a Wraith may spawn in is decided at random. The number of Wraiths spawned per room is increased as Hornet progresses through the Mist, starting with 2 in the second room Hornet enters, 3 in the third, 4 in the room after the crossing, and 5 from then onwards. This number is reset if Hornet fails the maze and returns to the entrance.
